evidenceScope: Static, read-only audit. Anchors and reproductions are implementation evidence, not claims of physical-mobile behavior.
status: Wave0 audit is blocked for implementation sequencing until P1 continuity/lifecycle gaps are resolved; no P0 was found.
rootCauseThemes: Independent route maps allow workspace identity drift.
Local loaders and optional callbacks fail open instead of exposing recoverable loading/error/retry states.
DOM-wide empty-and-rebuild rendering loses focus, scroll, and stale-response isolation.
Domain writers and approval controllers are usually separate and must remain authoritative, but their result projections do not preserve the next executable action.
Vault scans and read-side writes are unbounded or repeated, so mobile startup cannot be attributed or optimized safely.
Local responsive controls, nested scroll owners, raw colors, and emoji chrome bypass shared design primitives.

journeys.status: broken on failure and period boundaries

journeys.path: Reading session → candidate provenance → Knowledge review → source return
People/Places → source/candidate/approved Knowledge context → exact review
Project Wizard → Object/card/Today → first executable action
Workout load → draft save → completion → health tabs
journeys.status: broken on failure and expensive on load

journeys.path: Region load → bounded projection → popup/source command → Auction
journeys.status: broken on load, focus, and unsafe rendering

journeys.path: Obsidian/plugin startup → shell → first actionable control

findings.title: Personal route identity drifts between registry and Launcher
findings.reproduction: Home dock or WorkspaceSwitcher opens HUB/60 Personal.md, while the Launcher personal card opens HUB/70 Journal.md; the same label therefore reaches different hubs.
findings.impact: Workspace state and user intent are attributed to the wrong surface.
findings.nextAction: Derive every id→path mapping from workspace-registry and add a route equality receipt covering registry, Home, Launcher, Object Engine, and morning brief.

findings.title: Direct Home/Launcher links bypass canonical open and swallow failures
findings.reproduction: When openLinkText returns false or rejects without throwing synchronously, Home/Launcher leaves the user on the current screen without leaf fallback or recovery notice.
findings.impact: A central workspace entry can fail silently, so later journey steps never become reachable.
findings.nextAction: Introduce one canonical opener with extension normalization, falsy/rejection handling, leaf fallback, and scoped failure notice; route all Home/Launcher calls through it.

findings.title: Refresh, regenerate, Focus approval, and Journal save rebuild the whole Home subtree
findings.reproduction: Scroll Home, activate refresh or save, or trigger overlapping slow refreshes; dispose→empty→recreate resets scroll/focus and permits an older render to overwrite a newer one.
findings.impact: Continuity breaks exactly after an action that should return the user to the next step.
findings.nextAction: Use in-place projections where safe; otherwise snapshot/restore scroll and focus, guard renders with a monotonic generation, and disable duplicate activation while busy.

findings.title: Micro Log capture is advertised but is a static div
findings.reproduction: The compact quick-stream ‘빠른 기록 슬롯’ has no click, input, or keyboard handler and cannot begin a capture or Inbox handoff.
findings.impact: A visible primary action is non-functional and makes the Home→Inbox journey appear connected when it is not.
findings.nextAction: Implement the three-second capture control with explicit save/error/handoff states, or remove the capability copy until the existing Object creator path is wired.

findings.title: Inbox promises convert/archive but renders read-only tables
findings.reproduction: Inbox links open files, but there is no row/selection control for Object conversion or archive, no status/recovery state, and no explicit close/back focus contract.
findings.impact: The source→Object→review utility has no executable completion step.
findings.nextAction: Keep Inbox outside the first-class registry, but add explicit row/selection actions that call the existing Object creator, show pending/success/error, require confirmation before close, and restore/reopen focus deterministically; do not add archive behavior without a separate contract.

findings.title: Home mobile CSS overrides the AppShell scroll owner
findings.reproduction: Compact Home sets shell body overflow to visible and relies on inner padding instead of the shared bounded body and toolbar/safe-area clearance.
findings.impact: Touch scrolling and bottom action reachability differ from other workspaces.
findings.nextAction: Restore one AppShell body scroll owner and put toolbar/safe-area end clearance on the owner; verify narrow keyboard and touch focus paths.

findings.title: Home loader error has no retry callback or stable busy state
findings.reproduction: Make the required Home script unavailable; the error message renders without an actionable retry control and the loader does not expose stable busy semantics.
findings.impact: A transient plugin/iCloud/module failure becomes a dead end.
findings.nextAction: Connect retry to the same canonical mount path, expose aria-busy/live status, preserve deterministic shell geometry, and distinguish dependency failure from valid empty.

findings.title: Creator success and Project wizard do not project a common completion handoff
findings.reproduction: Create an Object from Home; the modal closes after a notice without refreshing Home. Create a Project; the wizard remains separate and the user must find a second open action.
findings.impact: The user cannot tell whether save completed, where the result lives, or what action follows.
findings.nextAction: Define a type-specific save destination, next surface, close/back behavior, focus return, and Home refresh callback without moving writer ownership.

findings.title: Launcher computes exact continuation targets but always opens the dashboard
findings.reproduction: A card labelled ‘계속’ or ‘이어 읽기’ opens card.path rather than the computed objectPath/continue_target.
findings.impact: The visible continuation CTA does not continue the current work.
findings.nextAction: Open the exact target and preserve return context, or rename the CTA to dashboard-only; add a target/path equality receipt.

findings.title: Launcher uses emoji where the design contract requires theme-aware icons
findings.reproduction: Launcher header/cards display emoji such as rocket, building, workout, reading, folder, and person icons.
findings.impact: Visual hierarchy differs by platform/font and violates the shared icon/accessibility rule.
findings.nextAction: Use Obsidian icon names with accessible text labels and shared icon-button primitives.

findings.title: Explorer rerender detaches pane scroll and active focus
findings.reproduction: Scroll the detail pane and trigger search, asset selection, brief completion, or hydration; renderExplorer empties the subtree and replaces the focused node.
findings.impact: Review and source navigation lose their place during normal async actions.
findings.nextAction: Preserve pane scroll/focus across projection updates, prefer stable nodes, and add a regression for each action path.

findings.title: Destroy does not invalidate in-flight hydration or AI brief responses
findings.reproduction: Start hydration or an AI brief, destroy the view, and mount a new view in the same container; the old response can repaint the new mount.
findings.impact: Stale state can appear under the wrong workspace or commit after the user has left.
findings.nextAction: Add mount token/abort invalidation, duplicate activation guard, and stale-response tests bound to a remount.

findings.title: Daily and long-period read failures do not become recoverable UI states
findings.reproduction: Reject Daily Vault reads or Monthly/Quarterly listRecords; callbacks either escape, leave loading copy, or discard records without a scoped retry.
findings.impact: A read failure is indistinguishable from an incomplete journal and blocks review.
findings.nextAction: Define staged loader states with stable previous content, aria-busy, scoped error, retry, named empty, and stale-version suppression across all periods.

findings.title: Weekly failure clears existing content and recovery actions
findings.reproduction: With saved Weekly content visible, fail a Daily read and refresh. Existing content is cleared, AI/save actions stay disabled, and catch does not restore retry paths.
findings.impact: A transient dependency failure destroys the last usable review state.
findings.nextAction: Keep prior projection while loading, expose retry and failure cause, and only disable actions whose input is actually unavailable.

findings.title: Quarterly readiness counts Monthly records by year instead of selected quarter
findings.reproduction: Put Monthly records in different quarters of one year and select one quarter; the year-prefix calculation includes records outside the selected bounds and directions aliases Quarterly files.
findings.impact: Readiness and planning guidance are numerically wrong while appearing valid.
findings.nextAction: Count records by canonical selected-period bounds and source Direction independently; add cross-quarter regression fixtures.

findings.title: Candidate approval/rejection has no deterministic focus fallback
findings.reproduction: Approve or reject the focused candidate; it is removed from the list and findFocusable(candidate) returns null without moving focus to the next candidate, launcher, or result.
findings.impact: The review queue becomes keyboard-hostile and the user loses the next work item.
findings.nextAction: Return focus to the next stable candidate, then launcher/result fallback, while leaving approval/rejection store ownership unchanged.

findings.title: Role/growth/review panels bypass shared tokens and primitives
findings.reproduction: Open Knowledge at a narrow or high-contrast theme; inline padding, radii, grids, and nested surfaces diverge from Explorer rhythm and theme aliases.
findings.impact: The same workspace has inconsistent visual density and weaker CJK/touch behavior.
findings.nextAction: Compose panels from existing token-backed card/section/toolbar primitives; remove local radius/grid/color values and preserve domain projections.

findings.title: Literature eligibility/read errors collapse into a generic empty state
findings.reproduction: Fail readSource or select a legacy Literature item lacking source_id/public/synthetic/HTTP metadata; the picker shows the same ‘no selectable Literature’ message.
findings.impact: The user cannot distinguish missing provenance from a true empty inventory, while the safe outbound boundary remains opaque.
findings.nextAction: Expose per-source eligibility/read-error status, original-open action, and explicit create-source path; never infer provenance or auto-fallback into approval.

findings.title: Knowledge tab and Journal period/date state are mount-local
findings.reproduction: Select PARA/LLMWiki or a historical Weekly/Monthly, close the note, and reopen; `_lastTab`, selected tab, and period key revert to defaults.
findings.impact: Cross-workspace review cannot resume where it left off.
findings.nextAction: Persist valid tab/period/date through the existing workspace-state/session contract and reset invalid values deterministically; do not add a parallel state list.

findings.title: Weekly exposes machine proposal IDs and emoji chrome
findings.reproduction: Repeated Principle or Next Week Direction rows display proposal_id as ‘ID:’ and use check/eye/lightning/hourglass characters as visual icons.
findings.impact: Internal identifiers and platform-dependent emoji leak into user-facing hierarchy.
findings.nextAction: Replace machine IDs with human labels or developer-only diagnostics and use theme-aware icons with accessible names.

findings.title: Scan, projection, render, and action-readiness receipts are missing
findings.reproduction: Delay a module/Vault scan or use a large catalog; implementation performs sequential reads but emits no phase durations, scan counts/bytes, DOM counts, or first actionable readiness.
findings.impact: Mobile slowness cannot be attributed to product work versus Obsidian/plugin/iCloud startup.
findings.nextAction: Instrument product/data/projection/render/readiness separately with a monotonic independent clock and export receipts outside Vault; bind campaign results to source/settings hashes.

findings.title: Module scans have no stable loading/busy geometry
findings.reproduction: Delay the first module Vault read; mount empties the pane until completion without aria-busy, status, or stable geometry.
findings.impact: Users see a blank surface and cannot tell whether the workspace is loading or broken.
findings.nextAction: Mount shell/status first, show polite busy state, retain geometry, and convert dependency failure to retryable error.

findings.title: Personal route identity differs by caller
findings.reproduction: Open a Personal continuation/action from Home or Object Engine, then use WorkspaceSwitcher; the first path can open Journal while the switcher opens Personal.
findings.impact: Route, state, and provenance are assigned to different hubs under the same label.
findings.nextAction: Apply route.personal.v1 to every caller and assert personal=HUB/60 Personal.md, journal=HUB/70 Journal.md.

findings.title: Required script and section loaders can remain permanently loading
findings.reproduction: Withhold or delay a required renderer; loader error has no retry, and section pollers clear after ten seconds into a loading/blank state.
findings.impact: A whole workspace becomes unusable without a local recovery path.
findings.nextAction: Implement staged timeout/error/retry states, retain selection/scroll, and ignore stale callbacks after disposal.

findings.title: Compact Reading focus targets a hidden/global card
findings.reproduction: Below 1024px select 이어 읽기 and click 이 책 포커스; global lookup scrolls a hidden or wrong card instead of revealing the current list pane.
findings.impact: The core Reading action appears to do nothing on compact layouts.
findings.nextAction: Scope lookup to the current workspace, reveal the list pane before scroll, focus the exact card, and restore focus to the invoking control.

findings.title: Project Wizard loses the first executable next action
findings.reproduction: Create a valid project plan and close the wizard; the card shows setup-needed and Today shows no assigned action even though workflow steps exist.
findings.impact: Project creation does not lead to an executable next step.
findings.nextAction: Persist explicit next_action or first unfinished workflow item and project one action receipt into card, Today, and Object projections.

findings.title: People and Places handoff rows do not select an exact candidate review target
findings.reproduction: Open a person linked to a candidate or a venue connected to one; actions open generic side notes/review rather than a typed source/candidate/approved row with exact candidate focus.
findings.impact: Personal context cannot complete the source→candidate→approved Knowledge journey reliably.
findings.nextAction: Emit typed source/candidate/approved rows with exact path/status/quality/source refs and candidate-specific review focus; do not create candidates automatically from People context without Evidence.

findings.title: Read failures are silently projected as empty notes
findings.reproduction: Fail Dataview or Vault reads for a contact/venue; readNoteText returns empty text and the row appears to have an empty body.
findings.impact: iCloud/plugin I/O failures erase provenance and context without an actionable error.
findings.nextAction: Preserve deterministic metadata with per-item read status/error and retry; only classify empty after a successful read.

findings.title: Places has nested scroll owners and sub-touch-target controls
findings.reproduction: At narrow width both venue list and detail use overflow/max-height while search/select/filter controls are 34/32/30px.
findings.impact: Touch gestures become trapped and primary filters violate the shared compact target.
findings.nextAction: Keep one active Places scroll owner, hide non-active pane scrolling, and use token touch targets with CJK-safe wrapping.

findings.title: Optional Reading history dependency failure becomes valid empty
findings.reproduction: Fail or remove ReadingView/ReadingStore; the optional loader skips the dependency and renders ‘최근 세션이 없습니다’ or blank output.
findings.impact: Dependency failure is hidden and the user cannot retry history loading.
findings.nextAction: Treat the dependency as strict for the history projection, expose error/retry, and render empty only after successful read.

findings.title: Personal tabs lack AdaptiveTabs semantics, persistence, and compact target size
findings.reproduction: At 601–767px or with keyboard, tabs remain 36px click-only controls without IDs, aria-controls, roving tabindex, arrow/Home/End behavior, or durable active state.
findings.impact: A primary Personal navigation control is not keyboard/touch consistent and resets across reopen.
findings.nextAction: Compose existing AdaptiveTabs semantics, use 44px compact targets, persist active tab via workspace state, and return focus on Back.

findings.title: Project cards use raw colors and an emoji delete affordance
findings.reproduction: Under theme/high contrast, raw hex/RGB values remain; delete is an emoji span without native keyboard semantics or visible focus.
findings.impact: Project visual and keyboard behavior diverges from shared UI rules.
findings.nextAction: Use theme aliases and an Obsidian icon button with accessible name, focus-visible style, and token target.

findings.title: Project status/refresh errors leave controls stuck or silent
findings.reproduction: Fail a frontmatter status write or refresh; the button can remain disabled and no inline error/retry is shown.
findings.impact: A failed action is indistinguishable from a pending action and cannot be recovered locally.
findings.nextAction: Always re-enable after settle, preserve card state, show concise scoped error, and retry only after a failed operation.

findings.title: People context rows are clickable divs without keyboard semantics
findings.reproduction: Keyboard-tab through recent context; rows have no tabindex/role/key handler and compact sizing is not guaranteed.
findings.impact: Source/candidate/approved context cannot be reached or activated consistently.
findings.nextAction: Use native button/link rows with accessible labels, focus-visible style, 44px compact target, exact source path, and return focus.

findings.title: Personal scans the full vault and sequentially reads contacts before shell readiness
findings.reproduction: Open a large/slow vault or trigger an unchanged Dataview rerun; enumeration, contact reads, and six bucket scans occur before the shell is mounted/reused.
findings.impact: Mobile first useful UI is delayed and repeated work is not attributable.
findings.nextAction: Mount shell/status first, bound scans/reads, reuse valid snapshots, and emit scan/read/projection/render/action-readiness receipts.

findings.title: Reading retains multiple scroll owners across wide and narrow layouts
findings.reproduction: Long list/detail content creates pane overflow inside AppShell; narrow transitions hide panes but retain competing scroll state.
findings.impact: Wheel/touch input can be trapped and toolbar/safe-area clearance differs by layout.
findings.nextAction: Define one bounded owner per layout, keep hidden panes non-scrolling, and record scroll restoration on compact focus actions.

findings.title: Auction→Region handoff is consumed before destination readiness
findings.reproduction: Region writes a scope/request and Auction deletes it before required modules finish loading; if a module fails, retry cannot replay filter/focus.
findings.impact: The cross-workspace journey loses its request at the exact point recovery is needed.
findings.nextAction: Use a one-shot request with destination ack/consumption after readiness; preserve it through failure and provide replay/clear actions.

findings.title: Auction polling has no terminal error/retry state or disposal
findings.reproduction: Withhold a section dependency; after the polling timeout loading copy remains and repeated renders can leave detached timers.
findings.impact: Auction can remain permanently pending and continue work after the user leaves.
findings.nextAction: Centralize poll lifecycle with timeout/error/retry/cancel, mount token disposal, and stable prior projection.

findings.title: Decision capture closes before atomic async persistence
findings.reproduction: Fail body vault.modify or omit both decision headings; frontmatter may already be changed while the modal closes without a retry/provenance-complete result.
findings.impact: A decision can be partially persisted and the user cannot recover or verify the final state.
findings.nextAction: Keep the modal open until the atomic writer settles, validate required headings, show pending/error/success, and preserve source/result receipt.

findings.title: Auction edit/delete/bid controls are non-semantic or undersized
findings.reproduction: Keyboard navigation cannot reliably activate span/div controls; narrow bid/delete/edit controls fall below the shared target and the bid header has intrinsic height.
findings.impact: A primary work surface is inaccessible and difficult to operate on mobile.
findings.nextAction: Convert actions to native buttons/links, apply token focus/touch styles, and test keyboard plus compact dimensions.

findings.title: Auction startup/query cost is unbounded and repeated
findings.reproduction: Open Auction with a large unrelated Vault; full-vault Dataview snapshots, folder queries, and file scans delay the first useful UI and repeat per section.
findings.impact: Mobile startup feels slow but no phase can be attributed or bounded.
findings.nextAction: Mount shell first, define bounded query/scan budgets, cache valid projections, and emit independent product phase receipts.

findings.title: Region scope persists beyond the one-use handoff
findings.reproduction: Open Auction from Region, navigate away, then reopen without changing the inline filter; the old district remains active and hides unrelated cases.
findings.impact: A one-time navigation context becomes an invisible persistent filter.
findings.nextAction: Acknowledge and clear one-shot scope only after destination readiness, while preserving it through failure/retry.

findings.title: Workout writes derived cache files during read
findings.reproduction: Open Workout twice and observe SYSTEM/AI/Memory/workout writes/index updates during startup.
findings.impact: A read path mutates Vault/iCloud and adds latency; external sync cost is confused with product rendering.
findings.nextAction: Make startup read-only; move derived-cache writes behind explicit/background lifecycle with receipts and failure handling.

findings.title: Optional health tabs disappear silently on module failure
findings.reproduction: Withhold health-shell/nutrition/running modules with debug disabled; only strength renders with no unavailable/sync-pending/retry state.
findings.impact: Users cannot distinguish a missing optional capability from an intentionally absent tab.
findings.nextAction: Render tab availability and scoped failure status, keep retry/cancel local, and preserve successful sibling tabs.

findings.title: Draft-save failures are swallowed and completion can lose latest values
findings.reproduction: Fail derived-session write, enter a set, and press 운동 완료; a notice appears but completion/refresh can proceed with the new values absent.
findings.impact: A user can believe a session was saved when the authoritative draft was not.
findings.nextAction: Track dirty/pending state, block completion until save settles or explicit discard is chosen, and expose retry with the draft intact.

findings.title: Workout narrow controls and nested scroll violate the mobile contract
findings.reproduction: At narrow width rest/chip/delete/import controls are 32/36px and long import/exercise content scrolls inside an already scrolling modal/panel.
findings.impact: Touch operation is unreliable and scroll gestures are trapped.
findings.nextAction: Use shared touch target and one-scroll contracts, keep modal content bounded once, and test CJK/long content.

findings.title: Region waits for sequential modules, all notes, and ledger/raw hashing before useful UI
findings.reproduction: Add many Region notes/snapshots; first usable explorer waits for unbounded scans and hashing rather than mounting a bounded shell.
findings.impact: Mobile cold startup is dominated by unknown data work and cannot be attributed to Obsidian versus product phases.
findings.nextAction: Mount shell/status first, bound scan/hash work, defer noncritical intelligence, and emit phase receipts with byte/count budgets.

findings.title: Region loader has no typed sync-pending or retry path
findings.reproduction: Withhold a listed module; the route shows a generic error with no retry and cannot distinguish iCloud delivery from product failure.
findings.impact: External delivery failure and product defect lead to the same dead-end state.
findings.nextAction: Expose loading, sync-pending, unavailable, error, and retry states with preserved request context.

findings.title: Region explorer rebuild loses focus and scroll
findings.reproduction: Scroll or keyboard-select a region, then filter/compare; the invoking control is replaced and position/focus jumps.
findings.impact: Comparison and Auction handoff require repeated navigation, especially on narrow screens.
findings.nextAction: Preserve stable projection nodes and snapshot/restore scroll/focus around filter/compare updates.

findings.title: Region intelligence overlay is not a focus-managed dialog
findings.reproduction: Keyboard-open 지역 상세 보기; focus is not moved into a labelled aria-modal dialog and Tab can escape to the background.
findings.impact: A modal-like action is inaccessible and can leave keyboard users lost.
findings.nextAction: Use shared modal primitive, label/aria-modal it, trap/restore focus, support Escape, and preserve opener context.

findings.title: Region popup interpolates unescaped data into innerHTML
findings.reproduction: Put markup in a Region title/cache field and open detail; the value is inserted as HTML rather than text.
findings.impact: Vault content can alter the popup DOM and violates safe rendering boundaries.
findings.nextAction: Use textContent/DOM construction or the shared escaping helper for every untrusted field; add markup-containing regression input.

findings.title: Workout breakpoint and mount lifecycle are unsafe
findings.reproduction: A narrow split pane inside a wide window uses window.innerWidth; rapid refresh/tab changes let old async renderers resolve into detached panels.
findings.impact: Responsive behavior and async state diverge from the active workspace.
findings.nextAction: Use container-aware layout state, mount tokens/disposal, and stale-response guards for health tabs.

findings.title: Running tab removes busy state before async data resolves
findings.reproduction: Delay a Vault read after selecting 러닝; the panel becomes blank with no busy state and overlapping retries can repaint out of order.
findings.impact: A healthy-but-slow tab appears broken and stale results can win.
findings.nextAction: Keep busy state until data settles, scope responses to the active tab/mount, and expose retry.

findings.title: Auction presentation bypasses theme tokens and uses emoji hierarchy
findings.reproduction: Switch theme/high contrast; hard-coded colors, shadows, and emoji remain in card hierarchy.
findings.impact: Auction looks unlike other workspaces and can lose contrast or meaning across platforms.
findings.nextAction: Replace raw colors/shadows/emoji with token aliases, native icons, and accessible labels; verify compact wrapping.

findings.title: Clipboard rejection is unhandled and guide close has no focus return
findings.reproduction: Deny clipboard permission, invoke the source command, and close the guide; status does not recover and focus is not restored to the ContextBar action.
findings.impact: A common source/provenance action fails silently and breaks keyboard continuity.
findings.nextAction: Handle clipboard rejection with inline fallback/copy status and restore focus to the opener on close.

evidenceLimits: No physical iPhone/iPad/Obsidian Mobile success is inferred from static inspection or logical-width screenshots.
iCloud and plugin startup effects are external until a controlled cold/warm campaign binds settings/source hashes and independent timing receipts.
Wave0 records current gaps; it does not authorize silent .obsidian mutation, plugin deletion, workspace tab reordering, writer rewrites, or automatic candidate generation from People/Places context.

verificationPlan.perFinding: Add a focused regression or live-surface receipt when the corresponding manifest row is implemented.
verificationPlan.boundary: Run contract audit, targeted suites, clean/review/QA cohort, and final mobile attribution campaign only after implementation waves.
